name: usage-corner
description: Model, effort, context window, 5h/weekly limits and session cost at the bottom right of the prompt, updated live, with a panel for details

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: nerd uses Nerd Font icons (needs a Nerd Font in the terminal); unicode uses plain symbols every font has.

alerts.title: Limit and context warnings
alerts.description: Show a toast when a plan limit reaches 80% or 95%, when it resets after a warning, and when the context is 80% or 90% full.

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Show what the session has cost in USD at the end of the corner.

usageRefresh.title: Background limit check
usageRefresh.description: How often an idle session re-reads /usage, so it sees what your other sessions spent. off checks only when something happens in this session.
